result.interpretation: GPU1 is not clean: kernel correlation proves the same address-zero gfxhub VM-fault and GPU-reset class as GPU0, but not the same row, profiled topology, or userspace manifestation. W7900 fails at row 49 serial q8 and aborts; RX 7900 XTX reaches row 173 independent q6, times out on a Redline completion signal, then loses HIP/Vulkan context and undergoes three full-device resets with VRAM loss while the harness continues.
